text:
maya (prod): Quick sync: customer asks collected this week — three asks: immutable append-only audit stream + verifiable export (Merkle proofs), BYOK onboarding path (pilot vs contract), and SOC2 evidence bundle format. Need a short decision to include in next roadmap draft.

ben (security): +1. For verifiable exports we can emit signed manifests with Merkle root for each export file. MVP: signed manifest + S3 export. Full: indexable cold store with proof-of-inclusion queries.

irene (infra): Feasibility notes: signed manifests are low effort (S). Cold index + inclusion queries requires indexing pipeline and proof-store, estimate M-L. Export throughput will need throttled workers to avoid noisy-neighbor impact.

ali (sales): Customers calling out "immutable" word. They want tamper-proof receipts. A couple of mid-market deals will make this a gating item. We should mark those accounts and offer pilot terms.

nora (legal): Legal: need chain-of-custody language + acceptance tests for evidence retrieval. For BYOK, we need a clear escalation/fallback policy if customer key unavailable. I'll draft an exhibit for pilot agreements.

ben (security): BYOK approach: (1) non-HSM wrapped key handshake for pilots (fast), (2) HSM-backed escrow + rotation for contracted customers. Must include attestation flow and emergency-unseal playbook.

maya (prod): Proposal: include signed-manifest export in GA for audit logs, mark Merkle inclusion queries as "enterprise roadmap". BYOK: allow non-HSM pilot in GA, HSM-escrow as enterprise add-on. Thoughts?

irene (infra): thumbs up. Will surface cost impact in the infra appendix.

ali (sales): OK but need a mitigation for BankCorp (they insist on HSM). Suggest early access program for BankCorp with prioritized HSM tickets and a service credit if not delivered by contract date.

ben (security): Agree on early access + monthly attestation for BankCorp. We'll prepare runbook.

audit-bot: Note: evidence-format-spec v0.9 published at https://redwood.internal/compliance/evidence-v0.9

maya (prod): Actions: (1) PRD stub with prioritized scope (maya) due Thu EOD, (2) security runbook + attestation template (ben) due Wed, (3) legal pilot exhibit (nora) due Thu, (4) infra cost appendix (irene) due Wed. Close unless blockers.
